sections.heading: How linkedin osint tool works in MyRecon
sections.body: Start with a single known identifier—a handle, email address, or domain—and run a targeted lookup in MyRecon. Standard scans query 560+ public platforms in the browser, while Extended scans (included in Pro and the 7-day free trial) expand coverage to 3,000+ sites alongside Deep Search for indexed public mentions.

sections.heading: Separating confirmed matches from false positives
sections.body: Automated tools classify each source into found, not_found, or unknown. Login walls, CAPTCHAs, and rate limits produce unknown rather than a fake clean result. Always open the source URL and corroborate profile photos, bio links, or timestamps before linking two accounts.

sections.heading: Ethical boundaries and privacy self-audit tips
sections.body: Use OSINT tools on your own accounts or for authorized research. If you discover forgotten public profiles, sign in to lock down privacy settings, remove reused handles, or delete unused accounts using official provider flows.

faq.question: Is MyRecon's linkedin osint tool workflow free to try?
faq.answer: Yes. Free accounts get 5 Standard scans per day across 560+ platforms and free email breach lookups. Pro adds Deep Search and 3,000+ platform Extended scans with a 7-day free trial.

faq.question: Can this tool access private profiles or hidden DMs?
faq.answer: No. MyRecon only checks publicly accessible sources and never bypasses login walls, private account settings, or platform access controls.

faq.question: How accurate is a cross-platform username match?
faq.answer: A matching username is a lead, not proof that the same person owns both accounts. Common handles are frequently registered by unrelated people.
